summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by GSK plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting transactions by PDMRs (directors) in ordinary shares and American Depositary Shares. The filing discloses open-market purchases by the Non-Executive Chair, Sir Jonathan Symonds (1,550 shares at £19.3524), and two independent non-executive directors, Elizabeth McKee Anderson (789 ADS at $50.6908), Charles Bancroft (1,855 ADS at $50.6908), Dr Anne Beal (745 ADS at $50.6908), and Dr Hal Dietz (no transaction shown) — all on the London Stock Exchange or NYSE. No special situation (merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review) is involved. This is a standard insider trading disclosure, not a corporate event.
